title: pARTy Composition: Building Balanced Art Teams in an Unbalanced Industry
description: Every game needs art, but not every game needs the same artists, at the same time, in the same proportions. Whether you're a solo developer wearing every hat, an indie team deciding where to spend a limited budget, or a studio leader planning department growth, success often comes down to understanding which art problems need solving now—and which can wait. Using RPG party composition as a framework, this talk explores how art direction, concept art, production art and technical art create value throughout development.
session_takeaway: Understand which classes of art problems to prioritize at various stages of production.
Using the RPG party framework to plan, scale, and balance art department capabilities.
Smarter decisions on where to invest limited art budgets for maximum return.
